emails.subject: Valle de Bravo opening moved to 3 March
emails.body:
Hi Inês,

Quick heads-up: the Valle de Bravo opening has moved from 15 February to 3 March. Construction is running late.

Could you send me a revised launch media plan with the new dates by Thursday? My director wants to see it before our Friday budget meeting. If the shift means we lose any early booking discounts on the media side, flag it.

Thanks,
Sofía

emails.subject: Paid social for the Nordics
emails.body:
Hi Inês,

Thanks for the chat at the conference in Copenhagen. We're planning to launch our winter collection in Denmark, Sweden and Norway in January and are looking for an agency to run paid social (Meta and TikTok).

Could you send rough pricing for a 3-month campaign and one or two relevant case studies? Budget for media is around 60,000 DKK per month.

Happy to jump on a call next week if that's easier.

Best,
Jonas Lind
Marketing Lead, Halden Outdoor
